title: Figure 1.1: UIUC spherical IEC device schematic, chamber photo and star-mode discharge
description: Three-part figure: a line schematic of a spherical vacuum chamber with central grid, labeled "Gas Feed Line," "Spherical Vacuum Chamber," "Grid," "To Vacuum Pump," "High-Voltage Feedthrough" and "High-Voltage Power Supply"; a color photograph of the IEC chamber interior with a glowing violet plasma at the center; and a color photograph through the view port showing the "Star Mode" discharge. Caption: "Figure 1.1. An UIUC Spherical IEC. The plasma discharge between the grid and vacuum wall creates an ion source that is extracted and directed towards the center by the highly charged negative grid." Appears in "Section I. IEC Background and Basics" on inertial electrostatic confinement fusion.
